a.prediction: Frozen full-model fold0 per-residue joint Hchi, original test output.
a.reference: Mean of original five consecutive 1000-frame windows; same MD trajectory, not independent MD replicates.
a.rho_definition: Spearman rank correlation; type-corrected rho frozen from earlier analysis
a.spread_CI_test: No interval or new significance test.

b.x: Frozen model joint Hchi minus mean prediction of same amino-acid type within chi layer, nats.
b.y: MD per-angle fine-bin entropy minus mean of same amino-acid type within chi layer, nats.
b.model_output_scope: One joint Hchi per residue; no single-angle model prediction or per-angle prediction error.
b.MD_metrics: Shannon entropy in 5-degree bins and total width of Fstar<=1 boxes; both averaged across four bin origins 0/1.25/2.5/3.75 degrees.
b.rho: Average-rank Spearman of all within-type-centered paired values per chi layer; all eight entropy/width associations retained.
b.zero_ties: Singleton types and constant groups retained; zero-overlap counts 3/3/1/0. No jitter or deduplication.
b.Pro: All three valid Pro residues retained in all defined chi layers.
b.pvalues_intervals: None. No new training or MD run; observations within one protein.

c.definition: 2 residues x 3 angles x 72 five-degree bins; retains original NaN zero-count bins
c.selection: Minimum Q41 and maximum Q2 frozen predicted joint Hchi among all six ubiquitin glutamines.
c.low_F_width: 5deg times number of finite boxes with Fstar<=1, origin0

vector: SVG editable text, no raster image nodes
